entries.name: Many-necked strike
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Many-necked strike

**Target:** Up to two adjacent creatures; each player rolls defense separately. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

entries.name: Second Head Watches
entries.effect: When an enemy within 2 starts a provoking action: Basic Melee before it resolves.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Second Head Watches

*While one head snaps forward, another turns toward the hand reaching for a spell or weapon.*

When a visible enemy within 2 squares starts an action that normally provokes an opportunity attack, make one free Basic Melee attack against it before the action resolves. Spend the Reaction. The 2-square reach applies only to this Reaction; the provoking action continues if its actor remains capable. No specialty attack or free-attack chain; cannot trigger from a free attack or its granted movement. This grants no extra Reaction and is an alternative to the normal adjacent opportunity attack.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Choose up to two adjacent targets and maintain only holds worth the shared Grappled restriction.

**Encounter and conversation:** The hydra's hunting pool lies across the only flooded causeway; lowering the water may reveal another route.

**Habitat:** Wild frontier; ancient ruin · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-hydra


**Category:** Beast · **Role:** Holder · **CV:** 59

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Many-necked strike | Brawn | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Grappled 1. | 10 physical damage. Grappled 2. |
| Driving strike | Brawn | 1 Boon | 2 physical damage. | 4 physical damage. Push 1. | 6 physical damage. Push 3. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 4/7/10

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 2

**Utility factor:** 1.75

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.6 → 1.75: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.15. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.596, O=13.787. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [brace ground](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/brace-ground.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [Second Head Watches](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/second-head-watches.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
